# Step - as_string

`as_string` · `asString` · category: [Strings and type conversion](../../traversal/step_reference.md#strings-and-type-conversion)

Converts each value to its string text (Scope.local: each element of a list); a list itself is a cast error.

## Forms

```text
as_string()
as_string(arg1: CastPolicy)
as_string(arg1: Scope)
```

## Example

```rhai,graph=modern
g.v(1).values("age").as_string().to_list()   // ["29"]
```

## See also

- [Type Conversion](../../users_guide/type_conversion.md)
